"North Korea fires multiple ballistic missiles towards the sea"
BYLINE: "By AP and Reuters" - AP and Reuters attribution. Photo credit: Kim Won Jin/AFP.

North Korea fired multiple ballistic missiles towards the sea off its east coast on MONDAY, South Korea's military said.
South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) said one missile launched from the PYONGYANG AREA flew MORE THAN 900km (559 miles). The JCS did not specify how many missiles were detected.
Japan's Deputy Defence Minister TAKASHI KOYARI said AT LEAST TWO missiles were launched 17 MINUTES APART and landed in waters OUTSIDE Japan's exclusive economic zone.
Koyari: the first missile flew about 220km (137 miles); the second more than 910km (565 miles), following an "irregular" flight path - and suggested it MAY HAVE BEEN A HYPERSONIC WEAPON.
South Korea's presidential office said the repeated launches violate UN Security Council resolutions, urging an immediate stop.
JCS spokesperson JANG DO-YOUNG said the launch appears to be a show of force, days after South Korea tested its own hypersonic weapon.
On THURSDAY, South Korean President LEE JAE MYUNG oversaw the country's first test-firing of a hypersonic missile - a rare public showcasing by a South Korean president. Lee's office said the weapon, once fully developed, would enhance South Korea's ability to strike key targets by surprise in the "Korean Peninsula theatre of operations".
On 3 OCTOBER North Korea tested a hypersonic intermediate-range missile designed to evade missile defences in South Korea and Japan.
Last week Seoul demanded an apology after a landmine blast wounded THREE soldiers in the DMZ. A joint South Korean-UN investigation concluded two landmines were planted by North Korean forces about a year ago; Pyongyang dismissed the claim and accused South Korea of provocation.
Kim Jong Un continues to flaunt his nuclear weapons programme while rejecting US and South Korean offers to resume stalled diplomacy. Talks between Kim and Trump abruptly ended in 2019.

NOTE: AJ says South Korea's hypersonic test was THURSDAY; CBS says FRIDAY. AJ says DMZ mine blast "last week"; CBS says "last month". See CBS cache file.
